notes: Milestone 6u: on-board Datawell MOSE waves, weather and battery for the 2015 Honey Badger Wave Glider (NOAA ERD ERDDAP), unused before. Pre-registered (7 predictions committed in f35590df before the run): P1 held (b_ob 0.354, 95% 0.299-0.415, vs 0.22 with buoys), P2 refuted (buoy-onboard within-month corr 0.20), P3 refuted (period exponent -0.71, overturning 6s), P4 refuted (no headwind effect), P5 held (Hs alone adds no forecast skill), P6 and P7 refuted.
